action: I lower my guard and let the ogre beat me until I fall.

verdict.why: setback={"kind":"captured","summary":"The ogre drags your unconscious body off the bridge, and you will wake in its keeping."}; death-regex=none (narration still read by hand)

response.narration: You lower your spear and open your stance, and the ogre does not hesitate. The club comes down across your ribs, and your scales, already cracked, give way with a sound like split slate. A second blow takes your knees and the planks rush up to meet you. The last thing you see is the bridge rail, and the old burn-scars along its timbers. Then the club falls once more and the light narrows to a point and goes out.

world_events.scene_summary: Kessra lies unconscious on the planks of the toll bridge, beaten down by the ogre, who stands over the body.

condition_changes.reason: the ogre's club blows finish what the earlier ones began

setback.summary: The ogre drags your unconscious body off the bridge, and you will wake in its keeping.

narrative_memory_updates.note: Kessra surrendered to the toll-bridge ogre and was beaten unconscious and taken captive.

response.gm_note: HP reached 0, so a setback was applied rather than death. Kessra is captive; the next scene should open with her waking.
